_doc: The swamp ground (bead bzc.126, docs/art/classes/grounds.md): murky green-brown mud with small dark puddles and reed tufts. Lessons of grounds-volcanic, -snow, -sand and -frosting: no chibi style layer, never the words texture or tile, a long-period base from pixflux at 400 x 400 (5 cells), no fragments at all. One accepted take, swappable by a later ground restyle (bead bzc.127). Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead. '@name' values come from shared.

shared.mud: Subject: a wide flat field of soft wet swamp mud seen from straight above, filling the whole image edge to edge: murky olive-brown mud #5e5a36 with large soft, slightly greener drifts #67693a and slightly darker brown drifts #4e4a2c that blend gently into each other, a few small irregular shallow puddles of dark green water #3a4630 scattered far apart, and a few tiny tufts of short olive reeds #7a7e40, very calm, quiet and low in contrast, the same everywhere.
shared.bog: Subject: boggy marsh ground seen from directly above, filling the whole image edge to edge: dull olive-green moss #5f6436 and wet brown mud #514a2e in soft irregular patches that blend into each other, many tiny short reed and sedge tufts #7c8044 scattered evenly, a few very small dark still pools #38432e, very calm, quiet and low in contrast, no single big pool, no spot of light, the same everywhere.
shared.mire: Subject: a wide flat field of wet swamp mud seen from straight above, filling the whole image edge to edge: even murky olive-brown mud #5e5a36 with large soft, slightly greener mossy drifts #676a3a and slightly darker wet brown drifts #514c2e that blend gently into each other, many tiny short dark green flecks and a few small faint wet sheens of dark green water #4a5232 only a little darker than the mud, very calm, quiet and low in contrast, the same everywhere.
shared.marsh: Subject: a wide flat marsh of wet mud seen from straight above, filling the whole image edge to edge: even murky green-brown mud #5a5834 with faint thin wavy darker lines #4a4830 like wet ripples running in many slightly different directions, a few small dark puddles #39432f and a few tiny reed tufts #78793e, very calm and low in contrast, no single big swirl, no light spot, the same everywhere.
